title: Chapter 416
text:
The captain's eyes widened. "Why is it my account? I didn't do it! Twenty-two hours ago … I was sleeping then! It's the culprit! The culprit stole my account! But … the login password is my fingerprint and iris. How could it be stolen … "

Everyone looked at him suspiciously. Maybe it was you. There were no surveillance cameras now, so you can act however you want.

"There are a few possibilities. The upper management of your tour group colluded with other forces to deal with us. It could also be that the other party somehow got the sample of the captain's body password, or … there's a disguise ability user hiding on the ship," Herlous said.

Everyone's expression changed. They looked at each other suspiciously. Everyone looked like an enemy.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and looked at the crowd. Everyone on the ship was gathered here. Even Sylvia was here. She hid at the edge of the crowd, revealing half of her face to look at him …

Suddenly, his eyes moved.

Wait, Sylvia?

Han Xiao finally realized where the strangeness came from. He looked at Dekker and asked, "Sylvia is your friend's daughter?"

Dekker nodded and said, "Yes, is there a problem?"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. "Her family … seems to only have her father left. If I remember correctly, that person is not a simple person. Heh, I was almost fooled by you. You're quite good at acting. If you confess, I'll be lenient. If you resist, I'll be strict. Do you want to say it yourself, or do you want me to say it for you?"

Dekker's expression froze. Disbelief flashed across his face. His eyes clearly expressed his shock and confusion.

How do you know Sylvia?

Although Han Xiao did not know the specific identity of Sylvia's father, he remembered that her father was a villain in the background introduction. That was enough. Dekker was just an ordinary employee of a business group. A villain was actually his friend. Although it was not impossible, it was still very strange …

Han Xiao shook his head. He should have noticed this long ago. It was just that everything was normal back then, so he did not think too much about it. It seemed that he had been a little lax recently.

Due to the one-month break in the League and the fact that he hadn't experienced any major dangers in the past nine months, he had subtly lowered his vigilance. Fortunately, he had detected it in time. He couldn't help but be alarmed.

At this time, Sylvia walked out with a frown. Her entire temperament had changed. The youthful vigor from before was all a facade. Although her body was still in puberty, the feeling she gave off was no longer that of a young girl. Her temperament had become mature.

Sylvia stared at Han Xiao. Her tone was complicated, mixed with astonishment.

"You recognize me?"

She couldn't figure out how Han Xiao could recognize her identity when it was the first time they met. Logically speaking, Black Star shouldn't know of her existence at all. She should have been hiding in the dark.

Sylvia had thought of many possibilities of being exposed, but she never thought that her identity would be exposed, causing her plan to fail.

In fact, if he didn't remember Sylvia's character background, Han Technician wouldn't have been able to directly identify the murderer. It was no accident that he suddenly met a future famous person!

"Black Star, my father was sent to prison by you. You bunch of mercenaries with no bottom line only know how to fight for money. For that, you didn't hesitate to help those tyrannical rulers suppress their suffering citizens. My father could have saved everyone, but you mercenaries harmed him!"

Sylvia gritted her teeth. Since she had been exposed, she would no longer pretend to be a young girl.

The players looked at each other, confused. Have we done such a thing?

Maple Moon couldn't help but ask, "Little girl, what's your father's name?"

"Langley! How can you forget his name! "Sylvia was agitated.

Opening the mercenary group interface, Han Xiao glanced at it. He really found this name in the mission history. This was a cooperative mission with the Purple Gold Army to eliminate a rebel base on a certain planet. The rebel leader's name was Langley. So, that guy was Sylvia's father.

Han Xiao was speechless. He had become a 'certain mercenary group' that dealt with her father in the background of Sylvia's character. What else could he say? It seemed like it was the butterfly effect again.

"Not only you, but also the Purple Gold Army. This won't be the first time. I'll hunt you down forever!" Sylvia shouted.

Bang!

As soon as she said that, the sound of a smoke bomb exploding came from behind them. Dark red poisonous fog rose.

You have been enveloped by some kind of poisonous fog. Undergoing END authentication. Your END is lower than 280. You are not immune to related skills. You have been poisoned.

Everyone hurriedly turned around and saw that the captain had already put on a gas mask. He was the one who threw out the poisonous fog bomb.

At the same time, the mechanical sound of the spaceship's system echoed throughout the spaceship.

"Automatic navigation changed. Destination is closest to the star. Warming up the hyperdrive engine. ETA: 13 minutes, 48 seconds.

"Spaceship entering lockdown mode. All gates are locked! I repeat, all gates are locked! "

Boom!

The door of the main control room slammed shut. All the doors of the spaceship were closed. The captain was already prepared. He dashed out before the alloy door on the other side of the main control room closed. He was so fast that Herlous couldn't catch the captain in time. He punched the metal door, leaving a shallow dent.

The alloy door in front of them blocked a small portion of the crowd outside. Sylvia was among them.

This time, Han Xiao and the rest were all trapped in the main control room.

The crew members were all shocked. The captain was with the enemy too?

Chi!

At this time, the ventilation pipes of the spaceship spewed out dark red poisonous fog. The air system had been tampered with long ago. It was all activated by the 'captain' with his authority.

Han Xiao held his breath. His eyes flickered.

Not only was it an assassination, but the spaceship itself was a complete trap for them! Sylvia could accurately predict their schedule, most likely because she was a tall tree that attracted the wind.

At this time, a new mission appeared on the interface.

You have triggered an emergency mission — Sylvia's Revenge.

Mission Introduction: Due to a common hire, you caused Sylvia to lose her father. Now, you are about to welcome the flames of her revenge.

Mission Requirements: Neutralize Sylvia's revenge method.

Mission Reward: 120 EXP.

"Tsk tsk, using the small to win the big, tricked us, and now wants to send us into the star and burn us to ashes. Not a bad idea. Did I beat up the old, and now the young is coming?"

Han Xiao chuckled. He was not worried at all. He was very familiar with this move. It was how he dealt with the Germinal Organization in the past.

"What do we do now?" Herlous looked over. He could breathe and talk normally. His Endurance was over 280. The poisonous fog could not hurt him.

"Her plan is quite interesting, but she missed out on the most important part …"

The mechanical suit opened up from the necklace. Pieces of armor covered the entire body. The helmet filtered the poisonous fog, and the poisoned status disappeared very quickly. Han Xiao walked to the main control panel, tapped on the screen, and brought up the spaceship's system interface. He moved his fingers, shook his head, and laughed.
